verdict.rationale: Sentry ships an official, documented sentry-cli that runs non-interactively for automation tasks: creating and managing releases, uploading source maps, debug files and snapshots (with GitHub status checks), managing code mappings, sending events, streaming logs and monitoring cron jobs. A REST API with bulk issue mutation supports scripted workflows. Pre-merge AI code review adds a CI-adjacent hook. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline setup docs (auth tokens, env-var configuration, example workflows), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI use, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404).
